name: dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b0_native_cb-cb2-COMMIT
purpose: Composed-budget native re-close of the direct-write scatter: native pin audit launch<=220/capture<=190 with exact/mutant benches; same RTL/pins/outline/2 stages

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_static_scatter_b8_out #(.BANK_BASE(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_static_scatter_b8_out.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b0_native_cb/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_direct_scatter_b0_native_cb/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: STRUCTURAL native re-close of the direct-write scatter (S81 VM F6 cb2, 2026-10-15): bank-hit compare drives only o_v; we/addr/mask/data/tag registered straight from pins (valid-qualified); fault from a raw valid pin flop vs registered o_v (FAULT_AGE 3); io_budget in 0.6 / out 0.57 at route, post-CTS boundary and sign-off; outhold off. Same pins/outline/root, zero data cycles.

reroute_reason.fix: native pin audit FAIL on the CLOSED view: capture 316.5 ps on 72 pins (i_row hash bits 64 + i_v 8: the bank-hit compare zero-gated ~155 output flops per record behind the pin; CTS gate with the composed 0.6T input budget alone still in->reg -142..-228 ps, so a constraint change cannot fix it) and launch 228.6 ps (unconditional FIRM outhold BUF-HB2-BUF). STRUCTURAL: the compare drives only o_v (fanout 1 per record); we/address/mask/data/tag are registered straight from the pins (as the upstream capture stage) and meaningful only with o_v; the relay->bank consumer writes only on valid (static512_suhc 128-SRAM gate: 3857 requests restored, bad 0, unchanged). cb1 (b0 0306988ee) closed NEEDS_RTL TT -23.03 / FF -22.66: setup on i_row->XNOR->AND5->rebuffer->AND3->o_we (206 ps: the shared compare also fed o_we and bad_q), hold on output ports (sender min L+75 ps vs flop->pin 52 ps with no room under the 0.6T output budget, worst output setup +18 ps). cb2: compare fanout 1 (we is payload; fault = registered raw v & !o_v, FAULT_AGE 3 unchanged), io_budget in 0.6 / out 0.57 (launch <= ~208 ps <= 220 at sign-off, leaves room for the 25 ps sender-min hold pads), outhold off. Same pins, outline, one root, two data stages, zero data cycles.
